findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 1, Harm 4
Raise: Gate
Case: normal use - a pull request changes web behavior and its web tests fail. This repair replaces `pnpm test` with an API-only Vitest command, while this workflow labels the resulting `tests` status as the one required tests check. That status can now pass without running the web suite. The separate CI workflow still runs `pnpm test`, but the supplied workflow identifies the Forge status as the required gate.
